raw_graphql_pull_request.body: ## Benchmarks Both models ran on `ar-early-stop-drafting` @ `c6d92c0590` plus the AV verify-cost fix (working-tree changes), with Model Runner V2 (`VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1`). Arms: fixed K=3 (AV off), AV only with K=5, and AV + early stop with K=5. Fixed K=3 is the best fixed draft length we measured overall on both models. **Workload (both models):** SPEED-Bench `throughput_2k`, all categories, chat endpoint. ```bash vllm bench serve --model --dataset-name speed_bench \ --speed-bench-dataset-subset throughput_2k --speed-bench-output-len 2048 \ --backend openai-chat --endpoint /v1/chat/completions \ --request-rate inf --max-concurrency $C --num-prompts $N \ --num-warmups $(( C < 16 ? C : 16 )) \ --temperature 1.0 --top-p 0.95 --top-k 20 --seed 0 ``` - C / N: 1 / 24, 8 / 64, 32 / 128, 64 / 256, 128 / 384, 256 / 768. - Each server first ran a discarded warm pass (C=64, 128 prompts, seed 1). - No request failed in any run. **Speculative configs:** | Arm | `--speculative-config` | |---|---| | fixed K=3 | `{"method": , "num_speculative_tokens": 3, "enable_adaptive_verification": false}` | | AV, K=5 | `{"method": , "num_speculative_tokens": 5, "enable_adaptive_verification": true, "adaptive_draft_depth": false}` | | AV + early stop, K=5 | `{"method": , "num_speculative_tokens": 5, "enable_adaptive_verification": true, "adaptive_draft_depth": true}` | ### DeepSeek-V4-Flash + MTP (4×GB200, TP4) ```bash FLASHINFER_DISABLE_VERSION_CHECK=1 VLLM_USE_FLASHINFER_MOE_FP8=0 \ vllm serve deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash -tp 4 --block-size 256 \ --max-num-seqs 256 --kv-cache-dtype fp8 --tokenizer-mode deepseek_v4 \ --moe-backend deep_gemm --no-enable-prefix-caching \ --kernel-config.enable_flashinfer_autotune=False \ --speculative-config '{"method": "mtp", ...}' ``` - The arms ran one after another on the same node: AV + early stop, then fixed K=3, then AV. - The benchmark client also used `--tokenizer-mode deepseek_v4`. - On DSv4's sparse MLA, the verify-cost fit finds a negligible per-request context cost (about 0.004 ms), so AV's pricing here is essentially unchanged by the fix. **Output throughput (tok/s):** | Concurrency | fixed K=3 | AV, K=5 | AV + early stop, K=5 | early stop vs. AV | early stop vs. fixed K=3 | |---|---|---|---|---|---| | 1 | 247.5 | 229.6 | 245.6 | **+6.9%** | −0.8% | | 8 | 1,022.1 | 1,078.4 | 1,132.4 | **+5.0%** | +10.8% | | 32 | 2,824.2 | 2,814.5 | 2,891.5 | +2.7% | +2.4% | | 64 | 4,419.9 | 4,511.7 | 4,653.1 | +3.1% | +5.3% | | 128 | 6,271.4 | 6,783.7 | 6,973.5 | +2.8% | +11.2% | | 256 | 8,120.5 | 10,000.0 | 10,522.7 | **+5.2%** | +29.6% | **Acceptance length:** | Concurrency | 1 | 8 | 32 | 64 | 128 | 256 | |---|---|---|---|---|---|---| | fixed K=3 | 2.32 | 2.31 | 2.32 | 2.32 | 2.32 | 2.32 | | AV, K=5 | 2.30 | 2.18 | 2.33 | 2.34 | 2.29 | 2.22 | | AV + early stop, K=5 | 2.23 | 2.11 | 2.32 | 2.33 | 2.20 | 2.11 | ### Qwen3-32B + EAGLE3 (GB200, TP1) This was benchmarked by cherry-picking the changes in https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/62988, which was necessary to correct the cost model for models with dense attention backends. ```bash vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3-32B -tp 1 --max-num-seqs 256 --max-model-len 8192 \ --no-enable-prefix-caching \ --compilation-config '{"max_cudagraph_capture_size": 2048}' \ --speculative-config '{"method": "eagle3", "model": "RedHatAI/Qwen3-32B-speculator.eagle3", ...}' ``` - Fixed K=3 and AV ran at the same time on separate GPUs of one node. - AV + early stop was rerun alone on the same GPU immediately afterwards. Its first run, made at the same time as the others, matched within noise (average +0.6%), so there's no warm-up effect. - The verify-cost fit gives 0.27 ms of context reads per request, versus about 0 per token. **Output throughput (tok/s):** | Concurrency | fixed K=3 | AV, K=5 | AV + early stop, K=5 | early stop vs. AV | early stop vs. fixed K=3 | |---|---|---|---|---|---| | 1 | 132.5 | 131.8 | 128.9 | −2.2% | −2.7% | | 8 | 924.8 | 857.3 | 883.3 | +3.0% | −4.5% | | 32 | 2,496.1 | 2,403.8 | 2,499.1 | **+4.0%** | +0.1% | | 64 | 3,566.3 | 3,424.8 | 3,568.0 | **+4.2%** | 0.0% | | 128 | 4,106.5 | 4,198.1 | 4,328.6 | +3.1% | **+5.4%** | | 256 | 3,831.5 | 3,971.4 | 4,112.5 | +3.6% | **+7.3%** | **Acceptance length:** | Concurrency | 1 | 8 | 32 | 64 | 128 | 256 | |---|---|---|---|---|---|---| | fixed K=3 | 1.96 | 1.95 | 1.97 | 1.96 | 1.96 | 1.97 | | AV, K=5 | 2.03 | 1.98 | 2.02 | 2.04 | 1.95 | 1.99 | | AV + early stop, K=5 | 1.91 | 1.94 | 1.97 | 2.00 | 1.92 | 1.93 |

+def make_depth_manager(
+    verify_cost_ms: np.ndarray, draft_ms_per_step: float
+) -> AdaptiveVerificationManager:
+    confidences = np.full((2, 3), 0.9, dtype=np.float32)
+    manager = make_manager(confidences, verify_cost_ms)
+    manager._stale_confidences = [SimpleNamespace(np=confidences)] * 2  # type: ignore[list-item]
+    manager.use_adaptive_draft_depth = True
+    depths = np.arange(4, dtype=np.float64)[:, None]
+    manager.cost_tables = (
+        np.broadcast_to(depths * draft_ms_per_step, (4, 3)).copy(),
+        verify_cost_ms,
+    )
+    return manager
+
+
+def test_draft_depth_stops_where_no_draft_would_be_verified():
+    # Any draft past the two bonus tokens costs 100x to verify, so the next
+    # budget admits none and every draft step past the prefill is wasted.
+    manager = make_depth_manager(np.array([1.0, 1.0, 1.0] + [100.0] * 6), 1.0)
+
+    assert manager.get_draft_depth(np.array([0, 1]), 3) == 1
+    assert manager._last_draft_depth == 1
+
+
+def test_draft_depth_keeps_full_depth_when_drafts_are_cheap():
+    manager = make_depth_manager(np.ones(9), 0.01)
+
+    assert manager.get_draft_depth(np.array([0, 1]), 3) == 3
+
+
+def test_undrafted_steps_are_planned_on_position_estimates():
+    # The last proposal stopped after one step, so the deep columns hold leftovers
+    # (0.01) rather than confidences. Planning must ignore them and use the
+    # per-position estimate, here confidently high, and so draft deep again.
+    manager = make_depth_manager(np.ones(9), 0.01)
+    leftovers = np.array([[0.9, 0.01, 0.01], [0.9, 0.01, 0.01]], dtype=np.float32)
+    manager._stale_confidences = [SimpleNamespace(np=leftovers)] * 2  # type: ignore[list-item]
+    manager._stale_draft_depths = [np.ones(2, dtype=np.int32)] * 2
+    manager.undrafted_confidence.sums[:] = 450.0
+    manager.undrafted_confidence.counts[:] = 500.0
+
+    assert manager.get_draft_depth(np.array([0, 1]), 3) == 3
+
+
+def test_position_estimates_count_only_drafted_steps():
+    estimates = UndraftedConfidenceEstimator(3, 3)
+    confidences = np.array([[0.8, 0.6, 0.0], [0.5, 0.5, 0.5], [0.4, 0.0, 0.0]])
+
+    estimates.update(confidences, np.array([2, 3, 1]), np.array([2, 0]))
+
+    # Slot 0 drafted two steps, slot 2 one; slot 1 was not in the proposal.
+    np.testing.assert_allclose(
+        estimates.sums, [[0.8, 0.6, 0.0], [0.0, 0.0, 0.0], [0.4, 0.0, 0.0]]
+    )
+    np.testing.assert_allclose(estimates.counts, [[1, 1, 0], [0, 0, 0], [1, 0, 0]])
+    np.testing.assert_allclose(estimates.population_sums, [1.2, 0.6, 0.0])
+    np.testing.assert_allclose(estimates.population_counts, [2, 1, 0])
+
+
+def test_position_estimates_lean_on_the_population_until_drafted():
+    # A request that has not drafted a step yet is planned on what other requests
+    # saw there; its own confidences take over as it drafts the step.
+    estimates = UndraftedConfidenceEstimator(2, 1)
+    for _ in range(1000):
+        estimates.update(np.array([[0.2], [0.0]]), np.array([1, 0]), np.arange(2))
+    population = estimates.mean(np.array([1]))[0, 0]
+    assert population == pytest.approx(0.2, abs=1e-3)
+
+    for _ in range(1000):
+        estimates.update(np.array([[0.0], [0.9]]), np.array([0, 1]), np.arange(2))
+    assert estimates.mean(np.array([1]))[0, 0] > 0.85
+
+
+def test_reused_slot_does_not_inherit_position_estimates():
+    manager = make_manager(np.full((2, 2), 0.5, dtype=np.float32), np.ones(7))
+    manager.use_adaptive_draft_depth = True
+    manager._confidence_probs = torch.ones(2, 2)
+    manager._draft_depths = np.zeros(2, dtype=np.int32)
+    estimates = manager.undrafted_confidence
+    estimates.update(np.full((2, 2), 0.9), np.full(2, 2), np.arange(2))
+
+    manager.add_request(0)
+
+    np.testing.assert_array_equal(estimates.counts[0], [0.0, 0.0])
+    np.testing.assert_array_equal(estimates.counts[1], [1.0, 1.0])
+    # The new request starts at the population mean, not the old request's.
+    population = (estimates.population_sums + 0.5) / (estimates.population_counts + 1)
+    np.testing.assert_allclose(estimates.mean(np.array([0]))[0], population)
+
+
+def test_budget_never_admits_slots_past_the_drafted_depth():
+    manager = make_manager(
+        np.array([[0.9, 0.9], [0.9, 0.9]], dtype=np.float32), np.ones(7)
+    )
+    manager.use_adaptive_draft_depth = True
+    manager._last_draft_depth = 1
+
+    manager.get_num_tokens({"low": 3, "high": 3}, {"low": [1, 2], "high": [3, 4]})
+    assert manager._batch_budget is not None
+    valid_drafts, num_non_draft_tokens, draft_budget = manager._batch_budget
+
+    assert valid_drafts == {"low": 1, "high": 1}
+    assert num_non_draft_tokens == {"low": 1, "high": 1}
+    assert draft_budget == 2
+
+
+def test_shallow_profile_seeds_per_depth_draft_costs(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        adaptive_module,
+        "get_tp_group",
+        lambda: SimpleNamespace(broadcast_object=lambda obj, src: obj),
+    )
+    manager = AdaptiveVerificationManager.__new__(AdaptiveVerificationManager)
+    manager.req_states = SimpleNamespace(max_num_batched_tokens=64, max_num_reqs=8)
+    manager.num_speculative_steps = 5
+    manager.num_bonus_tokens = 1
+    manager.use_adaptive_draft_depth = True
+
+    batches = list(manager.batches_to_profile([8]))
+    shallow = [b for b in batches if b.get("num_speculative_tokens") == 1]
+    assert shallow and len(shallow) < len(batches)
+
+    timings = [
+        StepTimingSample(
+            forward_ms=1.0,
+            drafter_ms=1.0 if batch.get("num_speculative_tokens") == 1 else 5.0,
+            num_target_tokens=batch["num_tokens"],
+            num_reqs=8,
+            full_cudagraph=True,
+            draft_depth=batch.get(
+                "num_speculative_tokens", manager.num_speculative_steps
+            ),
+        )
+        for batch in batches
+    ]
+    manager.set_initial_cost_curves(timings)
+
+    assert manager.cost_tables is not None
+    # Each decode step past the prefill-only depth adds an equal share.
+    np.testing.assert_allclose(manager.cost_tables[0][1:, 8], [1, 2, 3, 4, 5])
+

+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Confidence estimates for draft steps skipped by an early drafting stop."""
+
+import numpy as np
+
+# Pseudo-observations of the population mean each request starts with: until a
+# request has drafted a step this many times, its estimate leans on the
+# population's.
+_PRIOR_COUNT = 20.0
+# Most observations kept per request and step, and across all requests per step:
+# older ones are scaled down so the means follow recent confidences.
+_MAX_COUNT = 500.0
+_MAX_POPULATION_COUNT = 10_000.0
+
+
+class UndraftedConfidenceEstimator:
+    """Per-request, per-step confidence estimates for steps past an early stop.
+
+    A step's estimate is the running mean of that request's confidences in
+    proposals that drafted the step, shrunk towards the same mean over all
+    requests.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, max_num_reqs: int, num_steps: int):
+        self.sums = np.zeros((max_num_reqs, num_steps))
+        self.counts = np.zeros((max_num_reqs, num_steps))
+        self.population_sums = np.zeros(num_steps)
+        self.population_counts = np.zeros(num_steps)
+
+    def update(
+        self,
+        confidences: np.ndarray,
+        depths: np.ndarray,
+        idx_mapping: np.ndarray,
+    ) -> None:
+        """Fold in one proposal: each request's first `depth` steps.
+
+        `confidences` and `depths` are indexed by slot; `idx_mapping` holds the
+        slots of the requests in the proposal.
+        """
+        if len(idx_mapping) == 0:
+            return
+        num_steps = self.sums.shape[1]
+        drafted = np.arange(num_steps)[None, :] < depths[idx_mapping][:, None]
+        observed = np.where(drafted, confidences[idx_mapping], 0.0)
+        self.sums[idx_mapping] += observed
+        self.counts[idx_mapping] += drafted
+        self.population_sums += observed.sum(axis=0)
+        self.population_counts += drafted.sum(axis=0)
+        _cap(self.sums, self.counts, _MAX_COUNT)
+        _cap(self.population_sums, self.population_counts, _MAX_POPULATION_COUNT)
+
+    def reset(self, slot: int) -> None:
+        """Forget a slot's counts, so a new request doesn't inherit them."""
+        self.sums[slot] = 0.0
+        self.counts[slot] = 0.0
+
+    def mean(self, idx_mapping: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
+        # Steps no request has drafted yet start at 0.5.
+        population = (self.population_sums + 0.5) / (self.population_counts + 1.0)
+        return (self.sums[idx_mapping] + _PRIOR_COUNT * population) / (
+            self.counts[idx_mapping] + _PRIOR_COUNT
+        )
+
+
+def _cap(sums: np.ndarray, counts: np.ndarray, limit: float) -> None:
+    """Rescale to at most `limit` observations, keeping each mean."""
+    over = counts > limit
